the detection and prevention of early cardiovascular disease.
the detection and treatment of ED as a warning sign for the early detection of silent CAD.
the detection and treatment of ED, but we need to be mindful of the consequences of not detecting and treating ED.

‘The presence of ED in men with no known cardiac risk factors should prompt a detailed evaluation of cardiac risk factors, including the measurement of lipid profile, blood pressure, fasting blood sugar and smoking status’ (17).

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the ED is not just a marker for CAD events but also for increased mortality.
ED is an important predictor for future cardiovascular events.
erectile dysfunction (ED), or impotence, is not just an inconvenience for men, but a marker of early death.
The main takeaway from our work is that
ED can be used as a screening tool to identify patients at high risk for cardiovascular events.
ED is a marker for early cardiovascular death, and the sooner we can detect ED, the earlier we can intervene to prevent cardiovascular events and death.
ED is an early warning of cardiovascular disease and that it is not too late to act.
